activity.notes: Jogaila first ruled as Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1377 until Kęstutis displaced him in 1381. ATLAS records this as the first of two interrupted Lithuanian grand-ducal reigns, distinct from his later Polish kingship.

sources.title: Jogaila — Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia identifies Jogaila as Grand Duke of Lithuania in 1377-1381 and again in 1382-1392, and as King of Poland from 1386 to 1434.
